demo_name: ProofStudio One-Click Local Demo Seed Pack

campaign.name: ProofStudio Review Room Local Demo
campaign.brief: Demonstrate the full local Review Room demo path: create a campaign, run a safe dry-run by default, inspect attempts / assets / manifest / Provenance Passport honestly, and show the truth boundary. This seed pack holds deterministic demo inputs only; it never carries generated evidence.
campaign.audience: Hackathon judges, reviewers, and future contributors who need a repeatable local demo without remembering fragile manual steps.
campaign.tone: Operator-grade, evidence-first, honest about limitations. No hype claims.
creative_constraints: Default run must be a safe dry-run that calls no live provider and never touches B2.
Live mode must stay explicit and opt-in; it is never the default path.
No invented media URLs, no invented manifest references, no invented storage URLs, no invented digest values, and no invented provider or model claims.
The truth boundary must remain visible at all times.
Every piece of evidence is fetched live from the FastAPI API; nothing is hard-coded as successful.

safe_run.prompt: A safe dry-run for the local Review Room demo. Do not call any provider, do not call B2, do not fabricate media, and do not fabricate a manifest.

optional_live_run.prompt: A small explicit live proof image for the local Review Room demo.
optional_live_run.warning: Live mode may call external providers and B2. It is never the default and requires an explicit opt-in.

reviewer_script: 1. Run the one-click helper to confirm the repo, imports, seed pack, and a safe dry-run all work.
2. Open the Review Room URL and confirm the API Status card reports the backend online.
3. Create a campaign in the Campaign Builder (or note the seeded campaign id).
4. Click 'Create Safe Dry Run' and confirm the honest no-media / no-manifest state.
5. Inspect the Attempt Timeline, Assets, Manifest, and Provenance Passport panels for the dry-run.
6. Point at the Truth Boundary footer and read the non-claims aloud.
7. Optionally enable live mode (explicit opt-in) and click 'Create Live Proof Run'; show the live evidence or an honest failure/block.
8. End on the truth boundary: ProofStudio verifies workflow evidence, it does not prove semantic truth, legal authenticity, C2PA authenticity, or human authorship.
truth_boundary: PS-015 proves ProofStudio has a deterministic local demo seed pack and a safe one-click helper for preparing a local Review Room demo. It does not prove public deployment, production availability, authentication, production persistence, background job reliability, legal authenticity, C2PA authenticity, semantic truth, or human authorship.
created_for: PS-015 Demo Seed Pack + One-Click Local Demo. Deterministic demo inputs only; no generated evidence.
